proposed_decision.rule: Govern KE as a scoped clause-final interrogative operator and KU as a scoped interrogative content selector that is not equivalent to one fixed WH word. Retain KUVAN as an authored CANDIDATE closed locative specialization. Retain KUON as a recorded authored CANDIDATE but mark it DEPENDENCY_BLOCKED_FOR_ACTIVE_USE while ON remains GATE. No productive KU+DOMAIN compounding is created.
proposed_decision.rationale: Recovered distribution strongly supports scoped KE/KU functions; B7 strengthens the locative -VAN analysis supporting existing KUVAN. KUON, however, depends on ON=GATE and conflicts with the earlier explicit KU+ON prohibition, so active use must remain blocked until ON is separately resolved.

governance_decisions.proposal: Keep KE scoped to attested/governed question-like constructions; do not promote it to a universal interrogative operator for all HNK clauses.
Keep KU as a scoped content selector; do not globally gloss KU as WHAT, WHICH, WHO, WHERE or HOW and do not make KU+DOMAIN compounding productive.
Retain AUTH-001 KUVAN at CANDIDATE/CLOSED_LIST_ONLY as a locative specialization; B7 strengthens the -VAN rationale but does not promote KUVAN or create arbitrary new KU+VAN/KU+DOMAIN forms.

Retain AUTH-003 KUON in provenance/registry state but classify it DEPENDENCY_BLOCKED_FOR_ACTIVE_USE while ON remains GATE. Do not use, promote or bind KUON until a separate ON/person-domain gate resolves the dependency; do not delete it in B15.
Do not derive declarations from questions by simply removing KE, do not change general clause order, do not promote ON, and do not change curriculum/runtime state under B15.

approval_rule: A future SIGA may approve only DEC-B15-001 through DEC-B15-006 if this gate remains materially unchanged. The same SIGA must not approve B16, promote ON, create productive KU+DOMAIN compounding, activate KUON, or alter L03 curriculum.
